svg.text: 1. Drop page-blueprints.svg onto a Figma page. Each page column is one frame — 345.6 px wide on the canvas, so scale by 4.1667 to work at real 1440 px.

text.font-family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Ungroup once, then ungroup a section to get its blocks. Use the design-system.svg file for the colours, type styles, buttons, badges and the product card.

text.font-family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Rebuild a section by drawing over its block, then name the frame with the CSS class in the label (e.g. .collection, .section--ink) so engineers can map design to code.

text.font-family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Keep the section order. Each page is already ordered the way the live site is, from sticky header to footer.

text.font-family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
